seoTitle: Equity Dilution Calculator Across Funding Rounds
metaDescription: Follow your ownership through several rounds from investment, pre-money and option pool top-ups, with stake value. Free, private.
intro: Shows how your percentage shrinks round by round as new investors and option pool top-ups come in.
why:
Each round gives new shares to investors, so existing holders own a smaller part of a bigger company. The investor share is investment over post-money, and an option pool top-up taken before the round dilutes everyone but the new investor.

List rounds as name, investment, pre-money and optional pool percentage. The tool multiplies the share you keep each round. It does not model SAFEs, notes, preferences or anti-dilution, which can change the outcome.
howTo: Read ownership and stake value after each round.

faq.q: Why is the pool top-up included?
faq.a: Investors often require it before the round, which dilutes existing holders.
No. Use the SAFE calculator for one SAFE.

faq.q: Is the stake value a payout?
faq.a: No. It is a paper value at the round price, not what you would get on sale.
